live.heroMessage: Heimdall reads real sessions from your gateway and tells you whether the new version of your agent does better or worse than the current one. No answer key needed.
live.setupDescription: Three steps. Heimdall writes the settings file for you.
live.stepSplit: How can Heimdall tell the two versions apart?

canaries.heroTitle: Catch your agent or model quietly getting worse
canaries.heroMessage: A drift monitor re-runs a small, frozen test on a schedule and warns you when results drop.
canaries.cli: Prefer the terminal? heimdall canary init
canaries.stepWhen: When, and how much to spend

schedules.heroMessage: Pick a comparison, a time and a daily spending limit. Heimdall starts it for you.
schedules.integrationsHint: Get a message when results get worse or a run fails

inbox.heroMessage: Connect your gateway or tracing tool. Heimdall collects failed requests so you can turn the important ones into new test tasks.
inbox.integrationsHint: Tools to pull failures from, and access tokens for tools that send them in
